summary: Vocotap frontend verification for custom-music + cover-art-theme + polish. ALL 5 requested feature scenarios PASS end-to-end on https://vocotap-rhythm.preview.emergentagent.com (viewport 390x844). (1) TREESH MY MUSIC: cleared storage + deleted IDB, then seeded `treesh_media` at VERSION 3 with store `tracks` containing t1 ({meta:{title:'Seeded Song',artist:'Tester'}, audioBlob:<WAV Blob audio/wav>, audioType:'audio/wav', coverBlob:<1x1 red PNG>, duration:5}) AND t2 ({meta:{...}, audio:<ArrayBuffer>, audioType:'audio/wav', duration:5}). After reload, Library -> device-library-chip shows BOTH `song-card-treesh-mine-t1` (title 'Seeded Song', artist 'Tester', badge 'MY MUSIC', red cover art rendered) AND `song-card-treesh-mine-t2` ('ArrayBuf Track', 'Tester2', 'MY MUSIC', fallback letter cover) — see 02_library_device.jpeg + 10_library.jpeg. library-refresh-button spins and completes without error. The old VersionError bug (opening at fixed lower version while parent DB is at v>=2) is confirmed fixed: AppState.readTreeshMine() now calls idb.open('treesh_media') with no version arg and tolerates audio stored under multiple field names (audioBlob|audio|blob|file|data) as Blob OR ArrayBuffer OR data-URL. (2) AUDIO UPLOAD: Library -> import-audio-button opens a file chooser that accepts ANY type (type='*/*'). Playwright file chooser uploaded a generated test_upload.wav -> navigated to /analysis for that song (03_after_wav.jpeg shows Normal difficulty + Crown goals + 'Generate & play Normal' button). Uploading test_upload.txt -> import-error-banner appeared on the Library with text 'Couldn't import audio: That file isn't an audio track. Pick an MP3, M4A, WAV, FLAC, OGG or similar.' (04_txt_rejected.jpeg). (3) COVER ART THEME: played the seeded 't1' Seeded Song (has coverBlob). On the gameplay screen (classic theme — scene index 0) BOTH testIDs rendered: `gameplay-cover-disc` (red disc near top of highway) AND `gameplay-cover-backdrop` (blurred red image behind the highway) — see 12_gameplay_cover.jpeg (red-tinted gameplay with the disc visible above the top of the highway). Voco Warmup (no coverArt) played cleanly with NEITHER disc NOR backdrop testID present, no crash, no red screen (13_warmup_gameplay.jpeg — classic cyan/blue scene). Code review of /app/frontend/app/game.tsx L314-322 confirms Backdrop only renders <Image testID='gameplay-cover-backdrop'/> when src truthy AND theme scene is empty (classic path), and CoverDisc only when coverArt truthy — so Warmup correctly short-circuits. (4) POLISH: home PLAY `browse-library-button` is wrapped in a breathe Animated scale loop (0.9s in/out, 1.0->1.025) AND a shine Animated translateX loop (-120 -> CARD_W+60 over 1.4s, repeated with 1.8s delay) — index.tsx L31-37 + L159-165, both using useNativeDriver:true. No crashes while scrolling home. Wavy notes still render as continuous ribbon (previously verified iter13; this run didn't re-exercise long gameplay to results on cover song, but no crash on 5s mini-run). (5) Regression: /shop loads (red-screen=False) and /guide loads with guide-play-tutorial-button present (red-screen=False). No filtered console errors across the three runs (0 after ignoring treesh.app CORS, web shadow warnings, useNativeDriver web warnings, and ERR_FAILED on fonts/assets). KNOWN ISSUE CARRIED OVER (NOT fixed in this iteration): home-tutorial-card first-tap race — tapping the tutorial card immediately after a cold reload (<~1s after mount) silently no-ops; URL stays '/'. Waiting ~4s and tapping again navigates to /game?tutorial=1 reliably. Same iter-13 RCA still applies — useStartTutorial hook captures `songs` before the Voco Warmup `uri` resolves, so warm is undefined -> hook pushes nothing visible / falls through to /guide branch when ready is false. Not blocking (works after short wait) but is still user-visible on true cold-boot.

ui_bugs.issue: Tapping home-tutorial-card within ~1s of a fresh reload silently no-ops (URL stays '/'). After waiting ~4s the same tap correctly navigates to /game?tutorial=1. Carried over from iter13 — the hook captures `songs` from useAppState before the built-in Voco Warmup has a usable `uri`, so `warm = songs.find(s => s.source==='built-in' && s.uri)` is undefined and the callback returns early. Fix suggestion in iter13 (ref useRef(songs) OR pending-flag effect) still applies. Reference: /app/frontend/src/game/tutorial.ts.

action_items: MEDIUM (carried over, NOT fixed in this iter): useStartTutorial first-tap race. In /app/frontend/src/game/tutorial.ts, either (a) store songs in a ref that updates via useEffect so the Pressable's cached onPress always reads the latest list, (b) include `ready` in deps and queue a pending flag that an effect watches to auto-fire once songs populate, or (c) show a brief 'Loading tutorial...' micro-state and disable the Pressable until a built-in song with a uri is present. Workaround for users today is to wait ~2s after a cold boot.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/src/game/AppState.tsx L21-66 readTreeshMine() correctly opens treesh_media WITHOUT a fixed version (prevents the VersionError that silently hid My Music tracks once the parent app upgraded). onupgradeneeded re-creates the `tracks` store if missing so Vocotap never clobbers the parent DB. toUrl() tolerates Blob, ArrayBuffer, ArrayBufferView, string (data-URL/http URL) across fields audioBlob|audio|blob|file|data for audio and coverBlob|cover|coverArt|artwork|meta.cover for art — verified live for both the Blob (t1) and the ArrayBuffer (t2) code paths.

/app/frontend/src/game/AppState.tsx L133-164 importSong() now uses type:'*/*' and validates by extension list (mp3/m4a/aac/wav/wave/flac/ogg/oga/opus/aif/aiff/caf/wma/webm/mp4/m4b/amr/3gp/alac/mka/weba) in addition to mimeType.startsWith('audio/'). This fixes the 'can't upload any and all audio files' complaint. Non-audio (.txt) throws a clear human-readable error that the UI surfaces via import-error-banner.

/app/frontend/app/game.tsx L296-310 CoverDisc renders Image inside a square View at (cx - 1.6r, cy - 1.6r) with gameplay-cover-disc testID — correctly placed near the top of the highway. L314-322 Backdrop only mounts gameplay-cover-backdrop when src is truthy AND scene index is empty (classic theme) — otherwise HighwayScene replaces it. CoverDisc is only shown when `coverArt && !grayscale`, so Voco Warmup (no coverArt) and users who toggle `grayscaleCovers` won't see it. Clean guard logic.

/app/frontend/app/library.tsx L31 deviceSongs merges `songs` (built-in warmup + imported device) with `mineSongs` (IDB My Music) de-duped by id. Correct: fresh install shows Voco Warmup + seeded t1/t2 together under the 'On this device' chip, with t1/t2 labelled 'MY MUSIC' via the id-prefix check at L69 (`song.id.startsWith('treesh-mine-')`).

/app/frontend/app/library.tsx L35 doImport() shows import-error-banner on failure. Error message passes through unmodified so the AppState throw ('Couldn't import audio: That file isn't an audio track...') renders verbatim — matches spec requirement that '.txt -> That file isn't an audio track...' banner shows.

/app/frontend/app/index.tsx L29-37 breathe + shine Animated loops are correctly scoped to the primary (browse-library-button) and use useNativeDriver:true, so there's no JS-thread-blocking even during heavy renders. shine translateX uses the measured CARD_W, keeping the sheen horizontally centered on the button on any viewport width.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (5/5 requested scenarios verified end-to-end — Treesh My Music / Audio Upload / Cover Art Theme / Polish / Regression) with one MEDIUM carry-over race condition (home-tutorial-card first-tap)

seed_data_creation: Programmatically seeded IndexedDB `treesh_media` at version 3 with two records: t1 (meta:{Seeded Song/Tester}, audioBlob: generated 50ms silent WAV Blob 8kHz/16-bit mono, audioType:'audio/wav', coverBlob: 1x1 red PNG, duration:5) and t2 (meta:{ArrayBuf Track/Tester2}, audio: ArrayBuffer WAV, audioType:'audio/wav', duration:5). Also cleared localStorage/sessionStorage before each run to force fresh-install state. Generated /tmp/test_upload.wav (valid WAV header) and /tmp/test_upload.txt for the Audio Upload step. No persistence of these cleanups is required; subsequent testing agents should re-seed if they want to repro.
context_for_next_testing_agent: URL https://vocotap-rhythm.preview.emergentagent.com, viewport 390x844. For My Music testing, programmatically seed IDB `treesh_media` at a version >=2 (I used 3) with store `tracks` keyPath 'id'. Fields: audioBlob (Blob) OR audio (ArrayBuffer); audioType ('audio/wav'); optional coverBlob (PNG/JPEG Blob); meta.title/artist/genre; duration (seconds). Prefix the id with anything; the Song.id ends up as `treesh-mine-${rec.id}`. To re-verify VersionError fix, open the DB at an EVEN HIGHER version than you seeded at — Vocotap's readTreeshMine() must still succeed (it now opens with no version). Testing WAV upload via Playwright: use `async with page.expect_file_chooser() as fc: await import_btn.click(force=True); fc = await fc.value; await fc.set_files(path)`. For gameplay cover theme, the testIDs to check are `gameplay-cover-disc` (spinning cover at top of highway) and `gameplay-cover-backdrop` (blurred image behind highway — only rendered when the theme scene index is empty, i.e. classic theme). Pressables on home still need page.mouse.click at bbox center (iter13 note). home-tutorial-card race: wait >=3s after reload before the first tap, or your tap will no-op. shop + guide confirmed loading. Known iter-13-and-prior behaviours still hold: Playwright on web can't dispatch real touchstart+touchmove flicks (keyboard A/S/D/F path works), ignore treesh.app CORS + web shadow warnings + useNativeDriver web warnings + ERR_FAILED on fonts.
rca_of_issue: The custom-music 'not loading/showing' bug reported by the user had root cause: readTreeshMine() in AppState.tsx was previously opening `treesh_media` at a FIXED version (likely 1). Once the Treesh parent app bumped its DB schema to version 2 or 3, idb.open('treesh_media', 1) throws VersionError, the Promise rejects silently (the .catch(()=>{}) in L111 swallows it), and mineSongs stays []. Confirmed fixed in current code: idb.open('treesh_media') (no version) lets the browser open at whatever version is current. Live-verified by seeding at version 3 and seeing both t1 (Blob) and t2 (ArrayBuffer) records surface in the UI with MY MUSIC badges. Second contributing bug — strict audio MIME filter — was fixed by changing DocumentPicker type to '*/*' and validating by extension list + mime.startsWith('audio/'), so m4a/flac/opus/caf/weba etc. can now be uploaded. Verified by uploading a .wav (accepted -> /analysis) and a .txt (rejected -> import-error-banner with correct copy). Cover art theme bug — gameplay never used the song's cover — fixed by adding CoverDisc (top-of-highway) + Backdrop (blurred full-screen) components that read Song.coverArt (which is set from the parent DB's coverBlob via URL.createObjectURL in readTreeshMine, or from the Treesh catalog's coverart attr). Both only render when a cover is present and when the classic theme is active, so themed scenes still take priority and Voco Warmup (no cover) is a no-op — verified live.
